diagnostic_sources.warm-probe-flow.py:
import diag as d,json,time,pathlib,shutil
from peer import Peer
from recorder import Record
B='org.gewill.OpenCCman.OrientationInputQA'
def snapshot(n):
 c=d.run(['xcrun','simctl','get_app_container',d.U,B,'data'],n+'-data');f=pathlib.Path(c['stdout'].strip())/'tmp/orientation-events.jsonl';shutil.copyfile(f,d.P/(n+'-events.jsonl'));events=[json.loads(s) for s in f.read_text().splitlines()];assert events and all(x['mask']==26 for x in events);out={'native':d.native(n),'event_count':len(events),'last_event':events[-1]};(d.P/(n+'-snapshot.json')).write_text(json.dumps(out,indent=2));return out
start=time.monotonic();rows=[];failed=None
for group in range(1,7):
 if time.monotonic()-start>180:break
 for tag,args in [('open',['fold','open']),('inner-portrait',['rotate','portrait']),('half',['fold','half']),('closed',['fold','closed']),('cover-portrait',['rotate','portrait'])]:
  n='warmflow-'+str(group)+'-'+tag;r=d.sim(args,n);rows.append({'name':n,'result':r});print(n,json.dumps(r),flush=True)
  if args[0]=='rotate' and not r['data']['rotate']['confirmed']:failed={'name':n,'result':r};break
 if failed:break
obs=[]
if failed:
 deadline=time.monotonic()+8;k=0
 while time.monotonic()<deadline:obs.append(d.native('warm-failure-readonly-'+str(k)));k+=1;time.sleep(.5)
before=snapshot('warm-before')
(d.P/'warm-flow-result.json').write_text(json.dumps({'max_groups':6,'budget_s':180,'elapsed_s':time.monotonic()-start,'rows':rows,'failed':failed,'readonly':obs,'whole_matrix_passed':False},indent=2));print('FLOW END',bool(failed),flush=True)
if failed:
 display=before['native']['active_id'];assert display in [1,3];target='portrait' if display==1 else 'landscape-left';alternate='landscape-left' if display==1 else 'portrait'
 with Record('warm-peer-control',display):
  with Peer('orientation-persistent') as peer:
   ready=snapshot('warm-ready-no-report');first_ack=peer.send('orient '+target);time.sleep(3);same=snapshot('warm-same')
   repeated=None;alt=None;final=same
   if same['native']['rotation']!='rot0':
    peer.send('orient '+target);time.sleep(3);repeated=snapshot('warm-repeat')
   if repeated and repeated['native']['rotation']!='rot0':
    peer.send('orient '+alternate);time.sleep(3);alt=snapshot('warm-alternate');peer.send('orient '+target);time.sleep(3);final=snapshot('warm-final')
   elif repeated:final=repeated
   d.run(['xcrun','simctl','io',d.U,'screenshot','--display='+str(display),str(d.P/'warm-final.png')],'warm-final-shot')
 (d.P/'warm-comparison.json').write_text(json.dumps({'target':target,'alternate_value':alternate,'before':before,'ready_no_report':ready,'same':same,'repeat':repeated,'alternate':alt,'final':final,'root_cause_proven':False},indent=2));print('COMPARISON',json.dumps({'ready':ready,'same':same,'repeat':repeated,'alternate':alt,'final':final}),flush=True)

import diag as d,json,pathlib,time,importlib
from peer import Peer
from recorder import Record
from import_helpers import SOURCE,wait_text,shot,quota
Watch=importlib.import_module('busy-watch').Watch
c=d.run(['xcrun','simctl','get_app_container',d.U,d.B,'data'],'clean-import-watch-data');trace=pathlib.Path(c['stdout'].strip())/'tmp/duo-layout-trace.jsonl';before=d.native('clean-import-before-tap');assert before['active_id']==3 and before['rotation']=='rot0'
with Peer('clean-import-hinge') as peer:
 with Record('clean-import-cover',1):
  with Watch(trace,'clean-import-pending') as watch:
   tap=d.sim(['tap','--x','78','--y','275'],'clean-import-file-tap-once');ack=peer.send('hinge 0');actual=d.native('clean-import-immediate-display')
   d.run(['xcrun','simctl','io',d.U,'screenshot','--display='+str(actual['active_id']),str(d.P/'clean-import-immediate.png')],'clean-import-immediate-shot')
   wait_text('clean-imported',SOURCE,'');time.sleep(.3)
  shot('clean-import-final',SOURCE,'');quota('clean-after-import')
(d.P/'clean-import-timing.json').write_text(json.dumps({'tap':tap,'ack':ack,'actual_immediately':actual,'import_trace_busy_is_importing':False},indent=2));print('IMPORT COMPLETE',actual,flush=True)
diagnostic_sources.clean-convert.py:
import diag as d,json,pathlib,time,importlib
from peer import Peer
from recorder import Record
from import_helpers import SOURCE,RESULT,wait_text,shot,quota
Watch=importlib.import_module('busy-watch').Watch
c=d.run(['xcrun','simctl','get_app_container',d.U,d.B,'data'],'clean-convert-watch-data');trace=pathlib.Path(c['stdout'].strip())/'tmp/duo-layout-trace.jsonl';before=d.native('clean-convert-before-tap');assert before['active_id']==1
with Peer('clean-convert-hinge') as peer:
 with Record('clean-convert-inner',3):
  with Watch(trace,'clean-conversion-pending',peer,180) as watch:
   tap=d.sim(['tap','--id','workspace-convert','--element-type','Button'],'clean-convert-once')
   for k in range(400):
    if watch.sent:break
    if watch.error:raise AssertionError(watch.error)
    time.sleep(.01)
   assert watch.sent,'no busy trace observed; no hinge sent'
   for k in range(10):
    actual=d.native('clean-convert-display-'+str(k))
    if actual['active_id']==3:break
    time.sleep(.1)
   d.run(['xcrun','simctl','io',d.U,'screenshot','--display='+str(actual['active_id']),str(d.P/'clean-convert-busy.png')],'clean-convert-busy-shot')
   nodes=d.ax('clean-convert-after-hinge-ax')
   wait_text('clean-converted',SOURCE,RESULT);time.sleep(.3)
  shot('clean-convert-final',SOURCE,RESULT);quota('clean-after-conversion')
(d.P/'clean-convert-timing.json').write_text(json.dumps({'tap':tap,'before':before,'actual_after_hinge':actual,'trigger':'first new trace busy=true; one hinge report'},indent=2));print('CONVERSION COMPLETE',actual,flush=True)
